basic_profile.bio: A passionate crypto enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada, with a knack for exploring decentralized finance platforms. I spend most of my evenings and weekends diving into the world of blockchain, experimenting with different yield farming strategies. During the day, I'm a software developer specializing in open-source projects. I'm single, and when I'm not immersed in crypto, I enjoy playing strategy games and discussing anime. I'm a night owl, usually active online from 8 PM to 2 AM EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, with a keen interest in blockchain technology and decentralized finance. I started learning about crypto about two years ago, driven by a desire to understand the future of finance. Most of my knowledge comes from self-study, online courses, and active participation in crypto communities. My work as a software developer also contributes to my understanding of the technical aspects of these platforms.
